text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: As the day of the ceremony draws nearer and nearer, Carmina's practice gets more heated. However...
text_block_list.orig_text:
祭典の日が刻一刻と近づく中、カルミナの練習にも熱が入っていく。
しかし──

text_block_list.name: Nozomi
text_block_list.text: Finish!
text_block_list.orig_text: フィニッシュ！

text_block_list.name: Tsumugi
text_block_list.text: ...Phew, that was pretty good, wasn't it?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ふぅ、
今のとこ、
いい感じにできましたよね？

text_block_list.name: Chika
text_block_list.text: Yes, it's been properly corrected. Right, Nozomi?

一体どうしたら……
